n1a9f306dac.headline: Greek Company Bought Czech Brand Indulona, Also Owns Astrid | Aktuálně.cz
n1a9f306dac.summary: Sarantis, a Greek company, acquired the Czech brand Indulona for 216 million Czech crowns, adding to its existing ownership of Astrid.
n1a9f306dac.why: Sarantis is expanding its consumer goods portfolio in Central Europe through acquisitions, impacting regional market competition.
